name: ad-design-kit
description: AD Design Kit: a Figma ⇄ React + Tailwind v4 design system kept in sync by Claude Code skills, documented in Storybook.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run lint:tokens && npm run docs:check && npm run figma:descriptions -- --check && npm run figma:variants -- --check
scripts.storybook: npm run docs:build && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 storybook dev -p 6006
scripts.storybook:deploy: npm run build-storybook && npx -y netlify-cli deploy --prod --dir storybook-static --no-build --site 5c4cfb1c-721f-4500-aca8-f53b0d116efc
scripts.tokens:build: node .claude/skills/ad-design-kit-design-system/scripts/build-tokens.mjs && cp .claude/skills/ad-design-kit-design-system/tokens/ad-design-kit.css src/styles/ad-design-kit.css && npm run docs:build
